module: Old slow-motion (bullet time) API on the vehicle side, kept for mod compatibility. It only relays to `simTimeAuthority` in the game engine (GE Lua). Deprecated functions show an error toast in the UI and log a trace; use `get`, `set` or `selectPreset`.
usage:
local scale = bullettime.get() -- current time scale
bullettime.set(0.5)             -- half speed
notes: The old field `bullettime.simulationSpeed` is still read via a metatable: it returns `get() * 100` and logs a deprecation error (only once).
`set(v)` sends the value `1/v` to simTimeAuthority: v is therefore a speed factor (0.5 = half as fast); v = 0 would give a division by zero (inf).
`update`, `reset` and `slowMotion` are all the same `deprecated` function; `requestValue` also calls deprecated then forwards the request.

simulationSpeed.desc: Deprecated virtual field (via metatable __index): simulation scale × 100.

get.desc: Returns the current simulation time scale (`obj:getSimulationTimeScale()`).

set.desc: Asks the game engine to change the simulation speed, by running `simTimeAuthority.set(1/v)` on the GE side.

v.desc: Desired speed factor (inferred from code: the value sent is 1/v).

selectPreset.desc: Asks `simTimeAuthority.selectPreset` (GE side) to choose a speed preset.

v.desc: Preset, serialized by dumps (inferred from code).

requestValue.desc: Deprecated: shows the warning then calls `simTimeAuthority.requestValue()` on the GE side.

update.desc: Deprecated: shows an error toast "Deprecated API: bullettime" and logs a trace.

reset.desc: Deprecated (same function as update): error toast and trace.

slowMotion.desc: Deprecated (same function as update): error toast and trace.
